text: win_rate is a program too. It yields Spawn once per seed, and each Spawn starts a battle as a task.
Each task carries its own stack, so the hundred fights do not share a random generator.

The tasks take turns on one thread. At each Spawn, scheduled keeps the k of win_rate and runs the new task. No effect of a fight reaches scheduled, so the task runs to its end, and then win_rate goes on.
Gather waits for every task and gives back their results. Here, every fight has already ended.
On the same hundred seeds, the random bot wins seventy-three fights.
Change one argument, the player, and the Monte Carlo bot wins all one hundred.
A task's own handlers do not take Played, so it travels out past the Spawn, and one handler hears all hundred fights.
